fold_handling: Not applied in feasibility test; full Step 5B will apply participant-grouped folds

step5b_specification.failure_action: log and discard invalid replicate; continue to next
step5b_specification.failure_reporting: full inventory of reason per failed replicate
step5b_specification.fallback: If valid reps < 4750 (95% of 5000), switch to fixed-transformation bootstrap and report this as a scientific limitation
step5b_specification.refusal_condition: If valid reps < 4000 (80% of 5000), refuse refit-within-bootstrap; use fixed transformation as primary; refit as sensitivity only
